meta.title: {brand} — reservation system for restaurants

sections.title: What we collect
items: Your phone number — to sign you in and notify you about reservations.
Your name and interface language — you enter them yourself.
Restaurant team membership and role — if a restaurant invited you.
Your reservations: restaurant, date, time, party size and your note (once booking is live).

sections.title: Who sees it
items: A restaurant sees your name and number only for reservations made with that restaurant.
A restaurant’s owner and manager see the names and numbers of their own team members.
To send the SMS code, your number is passed to the SMS provider (Eskiz, Uzbekistan).

sections.title: Where and how long it’s stored
items: Data is stored on Supabase servers in Frankfurt (Germany) and sent over encrypted connections.
It is kept until your account is deleted.
To enforce SMS limits, a one-way fingerprint (hash) of your number is kept for 2 days.

sections.title: Your rights
items: You can change your name and language in your profile at any time.
You can ask to see or correct your data, or to delete your account. A contact for such requests will be added here before launch.
